summary.name: Art Text
summary.one_liner: Art Text is a Mac graphic design app for creating text effects, typography, logos, 3D text, and animated text graphics.
use_cases: Designing headings for print and web
Creating logos with text and vector shapes
Making animated titles for video or social media
Creating aged, scratched or stamped text effects
Exporting animated GIFs or transparent-background movies
summary.what_it_does: Art Text offers text styles, surface materials, bump maps, and effects, plus a material editor for custom shading materials. It includes a 3D modeling engine for converting text or symbols to 3D, and a Spray Fill / Spray Colorize tool for filling letters with images like coffee beans or Lego pieces. Text can be distorted (side distortion, erosion, blur) and masked for aged or stamped looks. Animations can be exported as movie or GIF files with transparent backgrounds for tools like iMovie or Keynote. The page also lists 1,100+ vector icons and shapes, a pen tool for drawing vector shapes, and AI features for generating typography from text prompts.
notable: Spray Fill and Spray Colorize for filling text with image objects
Animated text export as movie or GIF with transparent background
AI typography generation from text prompts and AI Wizard
caveats: Some design templates are available via in-app purchase
Page also describes a 30-day money-back guarantee; the page calls the app free but paid extras and purchases are mentioned
